one_liner: Plain is a B2B support platform with a full GraphQL API, OAuth apps, machine-user API keys and an official hosted MCP server (400+ tools). The pages show no free tier or trial, so the builder probably needs a paid workspace, but this is unverified.
auth_notes: OAuth apps (client-side with PKCE, or server-side with a client secret) are created self-serve under Settings → OAuth applications. Calls run as the signed-in user. Machine-user API keys (Bearer plainApiKey_...) carry per-key permissions. HMAC request signing and mTLS are used for webhooks and customer cards. The hosted MCP server uses OAuth only, requiring the openid and offline_access scopes.
access_notes: The pricing evidence lists only paid plans (Foundation $45/user/month billed annually, Horizon, Frontier). No free tier or trial appears in any fetched page, but absence is not proof, so this is a best-judgement label. Machine users and API keys are created in workspace settings.
blocker_notes: No free plan or trial is shown in the evidence, so a paid workspace is probably needed to get credentials. A trial may exist but is not confirmed.
